release_notes: Keeps the Mainkill1's Test Suite title and ten-second no-input autorun countdown.
Waits for deferred report publication after terminal-semaphore completion so the report-query oracles work on both OpenGL and Vulkan.
Uses a later valid report as the range-guard drain fence instead of waiting for the intentionally invalid report to publish.
Preserves all eight ordered ZPASS report-query leaves, structured report-memory evidence, and 149-record full-suite contract.
known_issues: The DMA descriptor-rewrite and range-guard leaves are xemu-only pending physical Xbox characterization.
A synchronous renderer may report completed_before_rewrite instead of pending_cross; both modes require complete A1/B0 records and an untouched B1 sentinel.
Whether BACK_END_WRITE_SEMAPHORE_RELEASE must itself make an earlier OpenGL report visible is a separate hardware-ordering question; v2 does not claim that uncharacterized rule.

resource_telemetry: process GPU engine, dedicated memory, and shared memory
